evidence.quote: Tanya (team owner) ruled on where reaction delivery belongs:

observations.why: A recorded ruling settles the question; the memo author reports a settling act rather than a tentative view.

evidence.quote: we route every reaction through one bundle per run per person

observations.why: Operational 'we route every' rule with a universal quantifier, stated as settled practice.

evidence.quote: Tanya held: the bundle closes when

observations.why: 'held' marks a committed position, and the rest is an operational closing rule. Not permanence language, so it stays at decision rather than principle.

evidence.quote: The alternative considered and rejected was per-skill

observations.why: Rejecting an alternative is a settling act, recorded as a completed decision.
